title: paeonia forrestii var. trollioides
intro: Paeonia forrestii var. trollioides, commonly known as Forest Peony or Troll Peony, is a variety of peony plant that belongs to the Paeoniaceae family. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia forrestii var. trollioides include its ability to calm the mind and body, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
